t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Don't pay attention to the hat colors of the gnomes. Instead, look at the size of their hats. One size of hats will produce more mushrooms until a round where two of the same hat sizes show up. At that point, the opposite hat size will start producing more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: I believe you should pay attention to the hat size of the gnomes. There are patterns where it's short hats that pay well. It switches to large hats paying better when you reach a round where there are two gnomes wearing the same size hat.
